overall.summary: Numbers, thresholds and directions reproduce; two small weakenings: the record says the network reproduces the 0.88 churn of frequent low-usage callers (it predicts about 65%), and one technical count (304 active rows) is 306.

findings.statement: gate kink moves up with each service call from 3 on; V-shape in day minutes; service calls enter only via hinges; AUC 0.901, acc 0.906
findings.check: probe day minutes at 1 and 4 calls; probe calls
findings.evidence: at 1 call the gate is off above ~165 min, at 4 calls above ~225 min; whole-model risk 3.0% at 91 min, 0.7% at 160, 90.5% at 352 (V-shape); AUC 0.9009, acc 0.906

uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-0d1892 --sweep "number customer service calls=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,8" --sweep state=49,43

findings.statement: frequent callers with low usage churn (empirical 0.88), which the network reproduces (also in operations.csc_usage_gate.hypothesis)
findings.evidence: empirical 88.5% (n=113) for <160 min, but mean predicted risk there is 65.4%; for <180 min 75.0% empirical vs 57.9% predicted. The network ranks this group high but does not reproduce the 0.88 rate
